snippet.title: Re:Blade | Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
Re:Blade is a fast-paced action roguelike built around short, intense combat loops.

Craft your build, adapt your strategy, and push forward against increasingly powerful enemies.
Every run evolves. Every decision matters.

Play the demo now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3421660/ReBlade/

Join the Discord (feedback & bug reports):
https://discord.gg/3PRbmRZm

Your feedback directly shapes development:
 • Combat tempo & impact feel
 • Difficulty & balance
 • UI clarity & controls
 • Bugs & quality-of-life issues

Wishlist and follow development on Steam.

#ReBlade #SteamNextFest #IndieGame #SoloDev
#ActionRoguelike #Roguelike #SteamDemo #Gameplay
